brief.headline: Starwood Property Trust Reports $390M Q3 Loss, but Sternlicht Remains Resolute
bullets: Real Estate: One quarter after Barry Sternlicht’s real estate investment trust (REIT) Starwood Property Trust reported a 95 percent annual net income drop, the bottom fell out for Starwood in the third quarter of 2026.
Fundraising: Brookfield Asset Management raised $12bn (£8.9bn) for its credit division in the third quarter, with total fundraising across the business reaching $25bn for the period.
Earnings & AUM: S&P 500 companies’ earnings are mostly topping analysts’ estimates — but by the narrowest margin in roughly four years.
AI & Technology: Barry speaks with Ann Berry, founder and managing partner of Threadneedle.

Real Estate: Starwood Capital Group and Trinitas Ventures have secured $100.3 million in construction financing to build Atmosphere Pittsburgh, a 672-bed student housing property near the University of Pittsburgh, Commercial Observer can first report.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,353.73 (down 4.4% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 28.2, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.84% (down 6 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.35 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.48%, near long-run norms (up 16 bps on the prior reading).
